summary: A grouped chat thread: two incoming bubbles from one sender with a name and avatar, then an outgoing read bubble.
use: Chat threads and support inboxes where consecutive messages from one person are grouped and your own replies show delivery status.
spec: `<MessageBubble direction="in" grouped="first" sender="Maria Souza" time="14:30">` opens the run and shows the sender
`{#snippet avatar()}<Avatar alt="Maria Souza" size="sm" />{/snippet}` in each incoming bubble
